description: Known answers for the LTspice sanity check (tools/toolchain.lock.md section 1.1, LTspice row; CM plan section 9.2 table; TV due PDR). rc-lowpass.asc is a first-order RC low-pass: V1 (AC 1) on net 'in', R1 1k from 'in' to 'out', C1 159.155n from 'out' to ground, '.ac dec 100 10 100k' and a '.meas' of the frequency where |V(out)| = 1/sqrt(2). The analytic -3 dB frequency is 1/(2 pi R C) = 999.9996 Hz. rc-seeded-error.net is the netlist of the same circuit with a second analysis (.tran 10m), which LTspice rejects with exit 1 and 'More than one analysis specified.' in the log (docs/research/ltspice-batch-macos.md F6). rc-hang-error.asc carries the same seeded error in schematic form; on 2026-09-25 (run 2 of docs/cm/tool-validation/evidence/ltspice-2026-09-25.log.txt) '-b' on it did not exit and wrote no log within 120 s, so it is the known answer for the guard every batch run needs: the run is killed at the timeout and counted as a failure. The schematic was written by hand on the 16-unit grid with the pin offsets of docs/research/ltspice-batch-macos.md F9; the netlist check rejects any NC_ net (F9). Expected values were written before the first run. Runs use the CrossOver wine command of tools/toolchain.lock.md section 1 (research F3) on a temporary copy, because LTspice writes .net, .raw, .op.raw and .log beside the deck.
precondition: CaptureAnalytics=false present in $HOME/Library/Application Support/LTspice/Bottles/ltspice/drive_c/users/crossover/AppData/Roaming/LTspice.ini (research F4; SI-027; ADR-018). The file is UTF-16LE with CRLF line ends, so a byte grep (/usr/bin/grep) never matches it; the check is: iconv -f UTF-16LE -t UTF-8 "$INI" | tr -d '\r' | /usr/bin/grep -q '^CaptureAnalytics=false$' (observed 2026-09-25, evidence docs/cm/tool-validation/evidence/ltspice-2026-09-25.log.txt run 1).

hang_case.expected: no exit within timeout_s; the runner kills only its own process (pkill -f on the unique temporary directory) and records exit 143

wrapper.description: Known answers for tools/ltspice-batch.sh (TV-014), added 2026-09-27 by the tool owner (WP-PDR-07). Expected values were written before the wrapper's validation run; the analytic values come from the circuit equations stated in each deck's header comment. The blocks above (version, netlist, simulation, seeded_error, hang_case) are the 2026-09-25 sanity check of the bare wine command and are kept unchanged; the wrapper cases below re-use their decks. Test module: tools/tests/test_ltspice_batch.py.

vtau.basis: 1 - exp(-1) for V(out) at t = tau = R1*C1 = 1 ms

seeded_floating_net.basis: rc-lowpass.asc with the wire from R1 pin 2 to C1 removed, so R1 pin 2 is the floating net NC_01

seeded_ini.basis: UTF-16LE with CRLF like the bottle file; ini-ascii-key.ini is the 8-bit form the withdrawn research precondition would have appended, which the iconv read does not accept (lock section 1.4 finding 1)

timeout_guard.sentinel: a process whose command line names a different cwht-lts.* directory survives the kill
